parsed.rationale: Diabetic patient with a 4-day-old plantar foot wound showing spreading erythema, swelling, and tenderness indicates a developing diabetic foot infection. These wounds carry high risk of rapid progression to deep tissue infection, osteomyelitis, and limb loss, and require same-day in-person wound inspection, probing, possible imaging/cultures, and antibiotic initiation. Absence of fever does not exclude serious infection in diabetics.
